title: Minimax ATE Estimation under Random Record Linkage with Few Correct Links
banked_reason: The main significance constraint is the highly specialized one-parameter model with symmetric binary arm probabilities, known exact k, one block, and no unknown baselines, linkage scores, or general outcomes, which limits its reach as an econometric ATE result.

proof_attempt_summary: The discovery stages derived an exact fixed-k overlap-mixture likelihood, matching minimax risk and honest interval-length orders, an attaining procedure, qualitative two-way critical-experiment equivalence, and critical risk transfer. The mathematical and rubric reviews passed, but the independent general referee graded the delivered package subfield because its one-block symmetric binary model has limited reach and its sharp deficiency rate remains open. Reaching field tier would require a broader sampling model or a new quantitative experiment-distance program.
tldr: A balanced binary trial is released after its outcomes are joined to treatment rows by a uniform one-to-one permutation with exactly \(k\) correct links. The complete release reduces exactly to the linked \(2\times2\) table, whose law is a one-dimensional fixed-point overlap mixture. The model has the all-\(k\) minimax and honest-length frontier \((1+\sqrt n|\rho_{n,k}|)^{-1}\), attained by a projected deattenuated contrast, and is qualitatively equivalent in both Le Cam directions to the critical product experiment when \(k_n/\sqrt n\to\kappa\). The corresponding minimax absolute risk converges to the Gaussian decision value, with the missed-elbow value exactly \(\delta_0\) at \(\kappa=0\). The main open boundary is the sharp uniform rate of the proved two-way Le Cam approximation as a function of \((n,d_n)\).
gap: Published linkage-error analyses provide attenuation, power, estimating equations, or contingency-table corrections, while published count-to-Gaussian comparisons do not contain a permutation conditioned on exactly \(k\) fixed points. The joint information in the outcome total and linked table is therefore not characterized at the weak-link threshold.
fill: The project derives the overlap-mixture likelihood, proves matching full-data decision rates for every feasible \(k\), supplies an attaining estimator and interval, and establishes the complete finite-information experiment with parameter-free comparison kernels.
